GPU 사양만으로 구성하지 않습니다. 사용할 모델과 입력 크기, 동시 작: We start with models, input sizes, concurrent work and storage needs, then design hardware, runtimes and operation together. Final configuration and scope follow consultation.
GPU 메모리는 어느 정도 필요할까요?: How much GPU memory do I need?
모델 가중치뿐 아니라 문맥 길이, 이미지·영상 해상도, 중간 연산과 동시: Weights, context length, image and video resolution, intermediate computation and concurrent work all use memory. The 16GB, 32GB and 96GB proposals are starting points to validate with your workload. System RAM and GPU VRAM are distinct.
GPU를 두 장 넣으면 메모리도 하나로 합쳐지나요?: Do two GPUs automatically combine their memory?
자동으로 하나의 메모리 공간이 되지는 않습니다. 분산 추론 지원, 모델: No. Distributed inference support, model partitioning, PCIe connectivity and communication costs all matter. Multi-GPU systems require a separate design discussion.
Mac에서도 H3를 사용할 수 있나요?: Can I use H3 on a Mac?
네. Apple Silicon용 H3 앱 Preview를 개발하고 있습니: Yes. We are developing H3 app Preview for Apple Silicon. It connects local chat, voice, image and video tools, with models and runtimes prepared separately. NVIDIA app integration is a later validation milestone.
인터넷 없이 사용할 수 있나요?: Can it work without the internet?
Local inference can work once models and runtimes are prepared. Setup, updates and optional external APIs may require a network. Offline scope and model licenses are checked for each configuration.
가격과 출고 일정은 어떻게 확인하나요?: How do I find pricing and availability?
현재 표시된 제품은 구성 제안입니다. GPU 공급 상황과 CPU·메모리·: Displayed products are configuration proposals. Quotes and timelines follow checks of GPU supply, CPU, memory, storage, installation and support. This website takes no payments or deposits.
